sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Price adjustment from 01 November 2026 - Strategic Partnership Review
move.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

We received your proposal for part:310010 at €138.55 (doc:20260911-70110-P01), citing a 9.5% increase. While we value our A-class relationship with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG (sup:70110), this price significantly exceeds our category goal for a stabilised supply.

Currently, our alternative source (quote:7200001) offers the same component at €143.22 with a 60-day payment term. Given our standard requirement for 60-day payment days and our need to maintain a healthy margin for your sustainable growth, we cannot accept €138.55 net 30.

Can you revise the price to €142.50 and extend our payment terms to 60 days? We aim to secure a long-term contract starting 2027-01-01 to ensure stability for both parties.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have carefully considered your request to shift the effective date to 1 January 2027 and extend the payment terms to 60 days. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. However, we are pleased to accommodate these terms to support our continued successful cooperation and provide the stability you seek. We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot stands at a price of €142.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
